The entry gives the device key everlasting_dominion_aram a word range (12 to 14) one word wider than the match of the key's inventory pattern in oshb Dan.7.14 (13 to 14). One exact span is ordered under a new part W11 (FIXUP-10), stated against the installed FIXUP-9 rows: in W4-004 boundary_evidence_refs entry 1, 'everlasting_dominion_aram at words 12 to 14 of 21' becomes 'everlasting_dominion_aram at words 13 to 14 of 21'. The fault is in the after text E11 worded, not in the W10 author's work, which applied it exactly. Lane TB's longer example wording is not adopted: the shorter span changes one number and adds no word. The grade is neither confirmed nor changed. Lane OS's support on the same record is not a contradiction of the measurement: both lanes report the match at words 13 to 14. No boundary, span, grade or unit type moves. Whether Dan.7.14 is 'the closing verse of the vision report' is a reading in a field that takes no tier word; it is unchanged here and stays with Fable's end review.
rulings.reason: The inventory defines the key by a pattern, and my own script finds one match of that pattern in the verse, at words 13 to 14 of 21; word 12 is the suffixed noun before it. In the installed rows every other place that gives a device key a word position (W4-007, W3-010, W4-009) gives exactly the match of the key's pattern, so a reader of these rows takes 'key at words X to Y' as the place of the device; on that reading the entry's first number is not what the bytes hold. Under OW-18 what a sentence implies it asserts, and E10's principle is that a row may not say what the bytes deny; E11 corrected this same entry for a low finding of the same kind. Choice (b), routing, was rejected because the defect is a number that a script decides, not a reading, and the boss would otherwise read a known one-word error; choice (c), closing, was rejected because the finding is true. Scale words relied on: the lanes' grading scale is not among my inputs (as E11 also recorded), so I regrade nothing; I rely on lane TB's own statement that if the phrase states the extent of the device 'the bytes refute its first word and the scale would give medium', and on the clause of E11 that an item asking a row change returns to me whatever its grade. The order rests on the measurement, not on the grade. The row's boundary_rationale stays true as it stands: it places the dominion clause at words 12 to 14 and says the key is listed there; after the change the entry places the key's own words at 13 to 14, inside that clause, so the two fields agree. All lanes and this ruling run on one model family (OW-25): the agreement of the lanes is one voice, and what counts here is the script output.
